lines.t: Yeah, we rise — no crown but Yours,
Light up the dark, hear our roar!
Every lie falls to the floor —
No idols, no idols anymore!
Flashing lights, they tried to blind my view,
All that fame, but it fades like dew.
Empty dreams couldn’t hold my soul,
Found my peace when You took control.
They said I could rule my world,
But I bowed before the wrong throne.
Now I’m breaking down that altar,
‘Cause Your truth’s carved in my bones.
All this gold, all this noise,
It can’t fill this void.
Only You, only You,
Can turn chaos into joy.
I don’t need idols, I need You,
Every heartbeat’s breaking through.
No spotlight, no stage can define,
Who I am — ‘cause You’re mine.
I don’t need idols, I need truth,
I was lost, but I found You.
Now I’m shining, shining through —
No idols before You!
Chained by the glitter, blinded by pride,
Till grace pulled me back to the other side.
Now I walk with purpose in every breath,
Life over fame, love over death.
We burn down the walls we built,
Trade the lies for the mercy You spilt.
Hands up high, we won’t hide,
You’re the King, You’re the light inside!
No idols! (Hey!)
No idols! (Yeah!)
Every chain’s falling down tonight —
You’re the only one who’s right!
I don’t need idols, I need You,
Every heartbeat’s breaking through.
No spotlight, no stage can define,
Who I am — ‘cause You’re mine.
I don’t need idols, I need truth,
I was lost, but I found You.
Now I’m shining, shining through —
No idols before You!
Outro – (soft echo / single voice)
No idols… just You.
